title: CMakeLists 静态检查器：目录级命令、缺 PUBLIC/PRIVATE 关键字、全局编译选项（正反两组实测）
expected_output:
[正例 GOOD] 逻辑命令=13 问题=0 判定=通过
[反例 BAD ] 逻辑命令=8 问题=9 判定=不通过
  CM009 error   文件级      缺少 cmake_minimum_required(VERSION x.y)：CMake 无法确定策略版本
  CM010 error   文件级      缺少 project()：未声明工程名与语言

  CM002 error   L2       link_libraries() 是目录级命令：链接依赖会泄漏给全部目标，应改用 target_link_libraries(<tgt> ...)

import re

# ---------------- 正例：现代 target-centric 写法 ----------------
GOOD = """cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(cppmind_demo LANGUAGES CXX)

add_library(core STATIC src/core.cpp)
target_include_directories(core PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
target_compile_features(core PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_compile_options(core PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)

add_library(log INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(log INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/log/include)

add_executable(app src/main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(app PRIVATE core log)

enable_testing()
add_executable(core_tests tests/core_test.cpp)
target_link_libraries(core_tests PRIVATE core)
"""

# ---------------- 反例：目录级/全局命令 + 缺关键字 ----------------
BAD = """include_directories(${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
link_libraries(pthread)
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -Wall")
file(GLOB SRCS src/*.cpp)

add_executable(app ${SRCS})
target_link_libraries(app core)

add_library(core STATIC src/core.cpp)
target_include_directories(core include)
"""

KEYWORDS = ("PUBLIC", "PRIVATE", "INTERFACE")


def logical_commands(text):
    """按「逻辑命令」切分：括号未闭合时把后续行并进来（CMake 允许跨行）。"""
    cmds, buf, start = [], "", 0
    for no, raw in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
        line = raw.split("#")[0].strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        if not buf:
            start = no
        buf = (buf + " " + line).strip()
        if buf.count("(") == buf.count(")"):
            cmds.append((start, buf))
            buf = ""
    if buf:
        cmds.append((start, buf))
    return cmds


def has_keyword(cmd):
    return any(re.search(r"\b" + k + r"\b", cmd) for k in KEYWORDS)


def lint(text):
    issues = []
    cmds = logical_commands(text)
    heads = [c.split("(")[0].strip().lower() for _, c in cmds]
    for no, c in cmds:
        low = c.lower()
        head = low.split("(")[0].strip()
        if head == "include_directories":
            issues.append(("CM001", "error", no, "include_directories() 是目录级命令：include 路径会泄漏给本目录全部目标，应改用 target_include_directories(<tgt> PUBLIC|PRIVATE ...)"))
        elif head == "link_libraries":
            issues.append(("CM002", "error", no, "link_libraries() 是目录级命令：链接依赖会泄漏给全部目标，应改用 target_link_libraries(<tgt> ...)"))
        elif head == "add_compile_options":
            issues.append(("CM003", "warning", no, "add_compile_options() 作用于本目录全部目标，应改用 target_compile_options(<tgt> PRIVATE ...)"))
        elif low.startswith("set(cmake_cxx_flags"):
            issues.append(("CM004", "warning", no, "set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS ...) 全局追加编译选项，应改用 target_compile_options"))
        elif low.startswith("file(glob"):
            issues.append(("CM005", "warning", no, "file(GLOB) 不会在新增源文件时触发重新配置，建议显式列出源文件"))
        elif head == "target_link_libraries" and not has_keyword(c):
            issues.append(("CM006", "error", no, "target_link_libraries() 缺少 PUBLIC/PRIVATE/INTERFACE 关键字：依赖语义未声明，无法正确传播"))
        elif head == "target_include_directories" and not has_keyword(c):
            issues.append(("CM007", "error", no, "target_include_directories() 缺少 PUBLIC/PRIVATE/INTERFACE 关键字：include 归属未声明"))
        if ("${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}" in c or "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}" in c) and head in (
                "include_directories", "target_include_directories", "link_directories"):
            issues.append(("CM008", "warning", no, "使用绝对路径变量 ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR} 拼 include 路径：目标被 install/被其它工程引用时会失效，应用 ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} + 相对路径"))
    if "cmake_minimum_required" not in heads:
        issues.append(("CM009", "error", 0, "缺少 cmake_minimum_required(VERSION x.y)：CMake 无法确定策略版本"))
    if "project" not in heads:
        issues.append(("CM010", "error", 0, "缺少 project()：未声明工程名与语言"))
    issues.sort(key=lambda x: (x[2], x[0]))
    return cmds, issues


for label, text, want_clean in (("正例 GOOD", GOOD, True), ("反例 BAD ", BAD, False)):
    cmds, issues = lint(text)
    verdict = "通过" if not issues else "不通过"
    print("[%s] 逻辑命令=%d 问题=%d 判定=%s" % (label, len(cmds), len(issues), verdict))
    for code, sev, line, msg in issues:
        where = ("L%d" % line) if line else "文件级"
        print("  %s %-7s %-8s %s" % (code, sev, where, msg))
    assert (not issues) == want_clean, "检查器判定与预期不符: " + label

print("[SUMMARY] 规则库=10 条（CM001-CM010）")
print("[判定] 正例 0 问题、反例 9 问题 -> 检查器可区分正反两组 = True")
